pointer_semantics: JSON Pointer paths ending in /* expand over every history item; no history item may be omitted

digest_recomputations.rule: decode canonical_bytes and hash the exact bytes; decoded bytes must equal JCS(payload) UTF-8 LF

invariants.rule: all pointer_equalities and canonical ref metadata (uri,version,schema_hash,canonicalization_hash,compatibility_profile,content_sha256,body_sha256) are equal to the same bundle
candidate_binding.binding_sha256 and canonical_bundle_sha256 are recomputed from the declared projections; D12 decodes a real canonical_bytes field and compares it byte-for-byte to JCS(payload)
every typed body digest and source content digest is recomputed before accept
every external ref is an exact URI in resolver_registry and path/bytes/sha256 match; URL/network/implicit base is rejected
unknown authority is typed_absent and cannot be fresh_refreeze_complete

valid_screen implies valid=true, authority=fresh_refreeze_complete, fresh_refreeze=true, join_checker_pass=true, all_ref_digests_pass=true, cas_pass=true, identity_pass=true, owner_pass=true, direction_pass=true, taxonomy_pass=true, typed_checker_pass=true

valid_screen requires replay_count=2, two unique attempt IDs, serial_order=[1,2], exit_codes=[0,0], semantic_equal=true, byte_equal=true, same environment/input/dependency hashes, nonempty raw/process refs

expected_version=before_version=edge.version=feedback_deletion.edge_version and after_version=before_version+1; immutable identity tuple (candidate_ref,source_ref,owner_ref,edge_ref,parameter,axis,direction) equals feedback, deletion, and every history item
history is non-empty; sequence is exactly 1..n, one append per accepted delete, no duplicate/skip/insert/delete/mutation; every item version links previous after_version to next before_version

before_state_bytes, after_state_bytes, operation_bytes and fail_atomic receipt bytes recompute to their declared hashes; rejected mutation preserves byte-identical state and history and appends nothing
recorded_utc is parseable UTC and ends in Z
record code maps exactly once to the concrete taxonomy class and resolution
review_end paths equal unchanged baseline paths plus this package paths only
